antibaseleak.screen.footer: Click a row to change it. Esc closes. Rebind the menu key in Options > Controls.
antibaseleak.section.status: Hook status (is the mod really working?)
antibaseleak.option.mask.tooltip: Replaces bedrock with an ordinary block, so its pattern never reaches your screenshots.
antibaseleak.option.mode.tooltip: AUTO decides for you. RENDER leaves the world untouched but misses Sodium. WORLD always works.
antibaseleak.option.cover.tooltip: NEAREST = texture of the closest block, SECTION = one block per 16x16x16 section, FIXED = a chosen block.
antibaseleak.option.radius.tooltip: How far NEAREST looks for a replacement block (1-4).
antibaseleak.option.fixed.tooltip: Block used by FIXED mode. Any block id can be set in config/antibaseleak.json.
antibaseleak.option.rotation.tooltip: Stone and netherrack rotations are derived from XYZ, so on a screenshot they give your position away.
antibaseleak.option.offset.tooltip: Grass and flowers are shifted based on XYZ - the same leak as rotations.
antibaseleak.option.debug.tooltip: Turns the whole section below on or off.
antibaseleak.option.position.tooltip: The XYZ / Block / Chunk / Chunk-relative lines.
antibaseleak.option.biome.tooltip: The biome narrows down where your base can be.
antibaseleak.option.difficulty.tooltip: Gives away how long the chunk has been inhabited.
antibaseleak.option.other.tooltip: Catches lines added by other mods when they look like coordinates.
antibaseleak.option.style.tooltip: MASK hides values behind characters, HIDE drops the line, BLUR blurs it on screen with a shader.
antibaseleak.option.blurStrength.tooltip: Number of blur shader passes (1-4). More means blurrier and slightly more expensive.
antibaseleak.option.chat.tooltip: Masks numbers in messages that look like coordinates (drops message formatting).
antibaseleak.option.toast.tooltip: A panel sliding in from the right with the menu key hint.
antibaseleak.option.reset.tooltip: Discards every change and writes the config file.
antibaseleak.status.tooltip: Turns green once the hook has actually run at least once.
antibaseleak.warn.sodium: [AntiBaseLeak] Sodium detected while replacement mode is RENDER - bedrock is NOT masked. Switch to WORLD or AUTO (F7).
